home.ambianceSubtitle: A terrace facing the sea, a real wood-fired oven, and the Italian spirit.
home.aboutText: At Zaguette family, Italy meets the Mediterranean. Our terrace in Aïn Achir opens straight onto the sea, and our traditional wood-fired oven reaches 400°C for that thin, slightly charred crust you can only find in Italy. 48-hour fermented dough, fresh pasta made daily, antipasti and homemade desserts. Real Italian cuisine, generous, savored while watching the sunset.
